nodes.name: build-exe.ps1
nodes.summary: Builds a single-file windowed ZaloBot.exe with PyInstaller from the project venv, scans the build output for leaked secrets, and copies the exe to the project root.
nodes.languageNotes: ASCII-only on purpose because Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads BOM-less files as ANSI.

nodes.name: install-task.ps1
nodes.summary: Registers Windows Task Scheduler tasks that launch the bot and the admin UI at logon through run-forever.ps1, with unlimited run time and automatic restarts.

nodes.name: Register-BotTask
nodes.summary: Creates a logon-triggered scheduled task that runs run-forever.ps1 with a given command, configures battery and restart settings, registers it and starts it immediately.

nodes.name: run-forever.ps1
nodes.summary: Supervisor loop that runs the bot or admin UI via python -m bot and restarts it after exit, logging to supervisor.log and stopping on config-error, lock-held and standby exit codes.

nodes.name: uninstall-task.ps1
nodes.summary: Stops and unregisters the bot and admin scheduled tasks, then force-kills leftover python processes running the bot or admin commands.
